crossRefs.note: David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered, and went…
The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate, and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son…

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

translations.web: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”
translations.bsb: But the king covered his face and cried out at the top of his voice, “O my son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!”
translations.kjv: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
translations.asv: And the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
